confirm-description: They are not banned. Their sessions, keys and tokens stop working and they are told what changed.
group-tokens: Revoke API keys and RMHCode sign-ins
group-webhooks: Disable webhooks and replace their secrets
heading: Secure account
help: Cuts off whoever else may be using this account without banning the member. Passkeys, linked sign-in accounts and the password stay. A signed-out browser can still read pages for up to 5 minutes, and an open live connection stays until it reconnects.
notice-body: RMH Studios staff secured your account after a report that it may have been accessed by someone else. What changed: {{list}}. Change your password and remove any passkeys or linked sign-in accounts you do not recognise.
notice-preview: Staff signed your account out everywhere and revoked its keys.
notice-subject: Your RMH Studios account was secured
reason-label: Reason (staff only, never shown to the member)
